subject.title: lossless-claw bootstraps into quarantine after every Gateway restart due to new sessionId generating fresh JSONL file

question: Should OpenClaw accept an opt-in `session.restartContinuation` config contract for aborted Gateway sessions, or should this lossless-claw restart continuity problem be solved by a broader restart-recovery design?
rationale: The source-level problem is clear, but the requested fix adds config/default surface in a session-state path where AGENTS.md and VISION.md require maintainer intent for compatibility-sensitive config behavior.

options.title: Review and land the opt-in PR
options.body: Accept https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94567's default-off `session.restartContinuation` mode if maintainers agree that explicit operator opt-in is the right compatibility boundary.

options.title: Fold into broader restart recovery
options.body: Keep this issue open but redirect implementation toward the broader Gateway restart recovery work if maintainers want session continuity to be automatic or coordinated with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/57425.

options.title: Reject core config for now
options.body: Close the direction only if maintainers decide the external lossless-claw workflow should rely on `/new` or plugin-owned recovery rather than new core session behavior.

recommendation.title: Review and land the opt-in PR
recommendation.body: Accept https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94567's default-off `session.restartContinuation` mode if maintainers agree that explicit operator opt-in is the right compatibility boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is mostly Gateway restart lifecycle and release compatibility policy, and this owner trail includes adjacent restart-drain work plus release ownership signals.
